response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong full-stack and some systems programming background, but he falls far short of the core requirements: he has only ~7 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years, his infrastructure/distributed-systems exposure (DLang low-latency services at Sociomantic) is limited relative to the role's large-scale compute platform focus, and he lacks demonstrated technical leadership of cloud or platform teams. The profile skews toward product/web engineering rather than cloud compute platform leadership.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured engineering career spanning web, backend, embedded, and systems work
Real low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record (workshops, courses, open-source projects)
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience against an 8-year minimum requirement
No formal technical leadership role managing priorities, deadlines, or cross-team alignment
Limited large-scale cloud/compute infrastructure architecture experience; mostly product and full-stack work

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud platform technical leadership
